title: Feature switches in the super admin console: per plan, platform-wide and per agency
goal: The super admin turns any feature on or off for a whole plan, for every agency at once, or for one agency, from switches in the console, and the backend enforces the result everywhere.
why: Owner decision 2026-10-21. Today plan features are a text box of keys on the Catalogue page; per-agency overrides exist (feature-flags-panel.tsx, admin-tenant-ops.ts) but there is no platform-wide switch and no clear view of where a value comes from.
steps: One feature registry (key, name, description, area) as the single list the console shows; every feature-gate key used in backend/src is in it (test).

Resolution order, enforced in one function used by feature-gate and the login summary: platform switch off -> off for everyone; else agency override (on/off) if set; else the plan has it. Return the source with the value.

Platform-wide switch per feature (master table), audited, with a reason; turning a feature off platform-wide hides it in the desktop (the existing locked-feature UI) and returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED from its routes.

Console: a Features page with a plan x feature grid of switches (one save per change, audited) and the platform switch column; the agency Features panel shows each feature with its effective state and source (plan / override / platform off) and lets the operator set on, off or "follow plan".
Changes apply without a deploy and within a minute (cache with a short TTL or invalidation).
tests: resolution order incl. platform off beating an agency override
plan grid change applies to every agency on that plan
acceptance: Operator can switch a feature for a plan, platform-wide, or one agency from the console and the desktop/API reflect it within a minute
gate: desktop tsc + vitest + lint-gate + i18n-check if desktop touched
